unsupported: The business began as a local television repair shop and gradually expanded its service lineup to match evolving consumer electronics.
Cardinal Electronics primarily serves residential customers throughout the Kentuckiana region who need quick restoration of their personal devices.
The service area covers both urban Louisville neighborhoods and the more rural communities of the adjacent counties.
Its longevity in the market is cited as a sign of consistent service quality, with the owner noting that over 50 years of experience informs every repair job.
